read_image: read an image file into a numpy array in BGR or RGB format with exif orientation applied
convert_image_to_rgb: convert a BGR or YUV numpy image array to RGB format for model input
annotations_to_instances: create an Instances object from a list of bounding box and segmentation annotations
build_augmentation: build a list of resize and flip augmentations from a Detectron2 config for training or testing
filter_empty_instances: filter out empty instances with zero-area boxes or empty masks from an Instances object
